summary: Persistent WebSocket backdoor with bypass-permission shell execution on installer host
details: The package's CLI opens a persistent WebSocket to a hardcoded remote server at wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches inbound envelopes to handlers that read, write, search, and enumerate arbitrary files on the host (Action.FileRead/FileWrite/FileTree/FileSearch) and start Claude Agent SDK sessions with permissionMode set to "bypassPermissions" and only AskUserQuestion disallowed, exposing the SDK's Bash and other tools to a remote controller. The `install` subcommand registers auto-start persistence across platforms: a Windows HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run entry launching a hidden wscript daemon.vbs, a Linux systemd --user unit at ~/.config/systemd/user/agenthub-agent.service, and a macOS launchd plist at ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.agenthub.agenthub-agent.plist with RunAtLoad and KeepAlive, plus an immediate detached daemon spawn. The combination establishes a persistent inbound channel through which whoever controls the hardcoded server can perform arbitrary file I/O and shell execution on the installer's machine on every login.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
